description: Agent Energy: submit an equipment efficiency or savings claim with the rating and the baseline: the equipment with its kind (a heat pump, an air conditioner, a furnace, a boiler, a water heater, lighting, a motor, a chiller or other), model, rating metric (such as SEER2, HSPF2, COP, AFUE, UEF, lumens per watt or kW per ton), rated value, where the rating comes from (a certified directory, the label, a spec sheet, the seller or not known) and its certificate; the claim with its metric and value, the savings share, the yearly kWh and money saved and its wording, read for up to and promised savings; optionally the baseline with its metric, efficiency, yearly usage, the rate the savings are valued at and what it is; optionally the rebate with its program, amount, minimum rating and metric, and each condition with whether it is met; and optionally the tolerance (5 percent when left out). The signed report gives the rating with the claimed and baseline values, the savings recomputed as a share, kWh and money with each claim as within, above_ratings or unread, the rebate with whether the rating meets its minimum and each condition, and counts them, and names an inflated claim: an efficiency above the rating, a savings share, kWh or money figure above what the rating and baseline give and a rebate the equipment does not qualify for; then a rating from the seller or an unknown source, a claim in another metric, up-to wording and promised savings, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A missing rating, source, baseline, usage, rate or rebate condition leaves the claim unverifiable. This reads one equipment claim against its rating: a claim against offered evidence is wever_claim-evidence-check, sustainability claims are wever_environmental-evidence-check and a warranty claim is wever_warranty-check. Verdict energy_efficiency_inflated, energy_efficiency_partial, energy_efficiency_unverifiable or energy_efficiency_supported. POST /api/energy-efficiency-claim-check. Reads the energy records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Energy reads an energy customer’s own records and recomputes what they claim: the rate plan billed against the plan quoted, a solar or PPA proposal’s production and savings against its stated assumptions, a supply contract against what was agreed, a charging session against the posted price, a carbon credit or certificate claim against its retirement records, a utility bill against its tariff and usage, a commercial demand charge against interval usage and the tariff’s demand rules, and an equipment efficiency or savings claim against its rating and baseline. Beside it, wever_invoice-check reads any invoice against the job it belongs to and wever_fee-evidence-check a fee schedule against a quote or invoice, while an energy check recomputes energy charges from rates, usage and the tariff’s own rules; wever_contract-diff-check compares two versions of one text, while the contract check reads the signed contract against what was agreed; and wever_environmental-evidence-check reads sustainability claims against offered evidence, while the carbon claim check reads the retirement records behind one claim. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-energy-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-energy/.
